verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents a Banking-as-a-Service offering. Developers can programmatically create connected accounts for businesses and individuals, give customers local bank details to collect funds in 60+ markets, and let them hold funds in 20 currencies via Global Accounts. That clearly covers the core of embedded banking accounts. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the platform operates under Airwallex's licenses so the developer needs no financial license of its own, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the BaaS onboarding flow.
